title: 第30章 哥，你是不是想包我？
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
唐仁祥都理不清李家的关系。

    很多时候，冷不丁就冒出来个李姓，跟江云李家有关系的。

    可能是某个部门的公务员，也可能是某个与他公司业务相关的。

    自从走上李家这条线后。

    他发现很多事情，只要不是大事，都变得很是顺畅。

    当然，他理不清。

    徐昂他们就更不明白了。

    但这不重要。

    重要的是，听唐仁祥的话，是认这些外侄的。

    “怎么？”

    唐仁祥问道：“他们出什么事了？”

    “也没什么事，就是在会所玩的时候，出了点误会。”

    徐昂说了一句，唐仁祥却继续追问，“什么误会？”

    “徐总，我可先跟你说了，要是其他人还好说，但李西海他们不一样。”

    “虽然年轻，父母也在江云，但他们有一个亲祖祖。”

    “他祖祖可是把李市长的父辈兄弟，一手带大的。”

    “现在还健在。”

    他声音很低，只有两个人能听到：“过年的时候，李市长是要磕头拜礼的。”

    唐仁祥这话绝对不是夸大其词。

    是亲眼所见。

    不仅是大字辈，胜字辈的也是。

    这是养育之恩，没有李西海祖祖，可能胜字辈都没几个人能在那个年代活下来。

    再怎么也不为过。

    至于西字辈，更是如此。

    可以说儿孙满堂。

    “嘶！”

    徐昂倒吸了一口冷气，他哪里还不懂，唐仁祥提醒的含义。

    “多谢唐总。”

    “我先去安排下。”

    “等等一起，反正吃的差不多了，正好散场。”

    “也成。”

    ……

    “姑父？”

    李西海几个人麻了。

    江云害怕被人撞见。

    但到了这市里，还特么一个接一个的。

    先是同学，之后是同辈弟弟，现在姑父更是来了。

    虽然这位姑父的关系有点远了。

    但那也是姑父啊。

    “玩的不错嘛。”

    唐仁祥似笑非笑，道：“西海，你没结婚就不说了。”

    “西英跟西雄，这样可要不得。”

    李西雄红着脸，没答话，笑着问道：“姑父，你怎么来了？”

    “听徐总提到你们，问了一下，真是你们，所以过来看看。”

    唐仁祥问道：“没事吧？”

    “没事，一场误会，说开了。”
content_en:
Tang Renxiang couldn't even figure out the relationship between the Li family.

    Many times, someone with the surname Li appears out of nowhere and is related to the Jiangyun Li family.

    It may be a civil servant in a certain department, or it may be someone related to his company's business.

    Since joining the Li family line.

    He found that many things, as long as they were not big events, became very smooth.

    Of course, he couldn't figure it out.

    Xu Ang and the others didn't understand even more.

    But that's not important.

    The important thing is that according to Tang Renxiang's words, he recognizes these nephews.

    "What?"

    Tang Renxiang asked: "What happened to them?"

    "It's nothing. It's just that there was a misunderstanding when we were playing in the club."

    Xu Ang said something, but Tang Renxiang continued to ask, "What is the misunderstanding?"

    "Mr. Xu, I have to tell you first. It would be easier for others to tell you, but Li Xihai and the others are different."

    "Although they are young and their parents are also in Jiangyun, they have a biological ancestor."

    "His ancestors raised Mayor Li's father and brothers single-handedly."

    "He's still alive and well."

    His voice was so low that only two people could hear him: "Mayor Li has to kowtow during the Chinese New Year."

    Tang Renxiang's words are definitely not an exaggeration.

    I saw it with my own eyes.

    Not only those with big names, but also those with better names.

    This is the gift of upbringing. Without Li Xihai's ancestors, perhaps few people in Shengzi's generation would have survived in that era.

    It cannot be overstated.

    As for the Western generation, this is even more true.

    It can be said that the house is full of children and grandchildren.

    "Hiss!"

    Xu Ang took a breath of air. He still didn't understand the meaning of Tang Renxiang's reminder.

    "Thank you, Mr. Tang."

    "I'll make arrangements first."

    "Wait a minute, we're almost done eating anyway, so it's time to leave."

    "Alright."

    …

    "Uncle?"

    Li Xihai and others were numb.

    Jiang Yun was afraid of being bumped into.

    But when we got to this city, it was one after another.

    First a classmate, then a younger brother of the same generation, and now my uncle is here.

    Although this uncle's relationship is a bit distant.

    But that's also my uncle.

    "You had a good time."

    Tang Renxiang smiled half-heartedly and said, "Xihai, if you're not married, let's stop talking."

    "Xiying and Xixiong, this is unacceptable."

    Li Xixiong blushed, did not answer, and asked with a smile: "Uncle, why are you here?"

    "I heard Mr. Xu mention you and asked about it. It was really you, so I came over to take a look."

    Tang Renxiang asked: "Are you okay?"

    "It's okay, it was just a misunderstanding."
title_en: Chapter 30 Brother, do you want to keep me?
